Resource-Constrained Job Shop with Provisioner.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Resource_Provisioner, General_Hospital_Triage

payload.content: RP ops plan (iter 1, planning): Checked inventories — both hospitals ALREADY at safe buffers (GH: IV 20, PPE 21; StM: IV 20, PPE 21). No transfers executed this phase to avoid holding cost; buffers confirmed stable. No resource failures active. I will monitor blackboard for any URGENT/DEFICIT requests and top up immediately if either hospital drops below IV>=6 or PPE>=8, or if any failure occurs (then raise to 12+ of the failed resource). GH Triage: no bottleneck risk at your end this phase — schedule freely. If your queue is small and you plan to take extra work, flag it here and I'll keep buffers topped.

GH Triage ops plan (iter 1): Job queue has 8 Triage step-0 patients (Patient_0..Patient_7), capacity 4, 1h each. Resource need = 8 PPE_Sets + 8 IV_Kits; GH inventory is PPE 21 / IV 20, so no deficit and no public top-up request this phase (buffers safe, avoiding holding-cost overstock). I will schedule all 8 queue patients early/spread across slots. No transfers planned. RP: no stabilization needed at GH this phase; will flag if a failure or drop below safe buffers appears.
